title: Read-only generic three-icon feature-row findings
description: # Read-only generic three-icon feature-row findings Next slice of LIM-e872b1 generic-template tells. Extends `limatus usability scan` only. ## DoD - Same CLI. New kind: `generic_feature_row`. - Profile: `template.flagFeatureRow` boolean, default **true** (same `template` block as `flagGradientHero`). Unknown keys rejected. Existing profiles still load; a profile with only `flagGradientHero` still gets this default. - When false, never emit this kind. - Flag a parent when it has **three or more consecutive sibling children** that share the same non-empty `class` token (first class if multiple) **and** each of those siblings contains at least one `img` or `svg` (including descendants). - One finding on the **parent** (selector of the parent). Do not flag 1–2 siblings. Do not flag siblings with no shared class. Do not flag if images are missing. - JSON: `id`, `kind`, `selector`, `rationale`. Add `generic_feature_row` to SKILL.md kinds list. - Tests (tempfile): three `.card` siblings each with `` flags the parent; two `.card` siblings do not; three `.card` without images do not; flag false suppresses; existing fixtures unchanged. - `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q` ## Out of scope - gradients, layout/overflow, decide/apply, live URLs ## Layout - Worktree: `/tmp/limatus-e872b1-feature-row` from `origin/main` - Branch: `feat/LIM--usability-feature-row` - PR target: **main** ## Inversion - Sparse pages and two-column layouts stay clean. - A feature row without icons/images is not this tell.
